newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends shade down in range trade.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends shade down in range trade.

text.p: *Peso averages at 26.374 to the dollar from 26.373
The Philippine peso ended a shade down on Wednesday at 26.374 to the dollar from 26.373, after both the U.S. amd Philippine central banks left their interest rates unchanged, traders said.
"It's just sideways movement," said one trader.
But volume rose to $180.7 million from $137 million.
Some banks continue to be wary after the recent pressure on the peso from problems in Thailand, and bought dollarss at 26.375.
The Central Bank was not seen intervening today.
Traders said the Philippines Central Bank could decide to keep its rates at the current more than two-year highs to ward off anyfresh attacks on the peso.
